# disputed

- **CURIE:** [`gmeow:determinacyDisputed`](gmeow-determinacyDisputed.md)
- **IRI:** <https://blackcatinformatics.ca/gmeow/determinacyDisputed>
- **Category:** individual

- **Box roles:** [ABox role](../boxes/abox.md), [CBox role](../boxes/cbox.md) ([What is this?](../../four-boxes/index.md))

The disputed determinacy — a characterization of whether a value is crisp, vague, fuzzy, probabilistic, or disputed ([Principle 9](https://github.com/Blackcat-Informatics/gmeow-ontology/blob/main/CONSTITUTION.md#principle-9)).
